title: Secure the First Relay Station
briefing: The relay route is your first major POI push. It is real, useful, and exposed: check weather, scan the relay console, repair the coupler, claim the cache, and return before chasing locked routes.

objectives.label: Open Major Route Records
objectives.detail: Confirm First Relay Station is the selected route and future markers are locked.

objectives.label: Check the relay weather window
objectives.detail: Delay the route during active toxic fronts unless you have filters, clean water, and a marked exit.

objectives.label: Track the First Relay Station marker
objectives.detail: Use the first major route HoloMap layer and ignore locked future routes.

objectives.label: Scan the relay console
objectives.detail: Confirm this is the relay station POI and open its Index guide.

objectives.label: Repair or document the relay power coupler
objectives.detail: Use relay repair guidance; if repair is blocked, document missing input/status text.

objectives.label: Claim the relay cache
objectives.detail: The cache should support power, scanner, and next-route prep without skipping late systems.

objectives.label: Return and update Terminal
objectives.detail: Return to shelter and confirm What Now points to the next safe route state.

completionText: Relay route secured. You now have a tested major-route pattern: prep, scan, repair, cache, return, then choose the next route intentionally.
